job.prompt: Create a realistic application hero image for electrical installation and utility work using insulated hand tools. Show a professional electrical panel or switchgear environment where VDE-rated insulated screwdrivers, pliers, and diagonal cutters are neatly arranged. The scene should communicate electrical safety, compliance with 1000V insulation standards, and professional trade use. Clean industrial environment, yellow-red insulation handle color visible but not cartoonish. No dangerous sparks, no dramatic scenes.
